2026_04_DAL_HOU.headline: Nico Collins returns to test a reshuffled Dallas secondary in the Battle of Texas
2026_04_DAL_HOU.paragraph1: Houston gets a major piece back with Nico Collins returning to C.J. Stroud's receiving corps, just as Dallas tries to stabilize an injury-hit defense under Brian Schottenheimer. DeMarvion Overshown remains out, while Malik Hooker's return and the addition of Joey Porter Jr. give the Cowboys more options behind Quinnen Williams' interior rush. On the other side, Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb face a Houston defense built around Will Anderson Jr., Derek Stingley Jr. and Kamari Lassiter. Quarterback protection and explosive-pass prevention shape this matchup.
2026_04_DAL_HOU.model_rationale: Houston's restored receiving threat can stress Dallas' changing coverage combinations, while the Cowboys' offense must manage a disruptive Texans front and a talented cornerback group.
